purpose: Continue the user-directed historical factor-combination engine with a finite current-library campaign while preserving every prior terminal factor record and Candidate49 as a separate prospective layer.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: complete_140_numeric_library_monotone_histogram_gradient_boosting
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The user-frozen historical policy explicitly permits complete-library combinations and model fitting inside development folds. Direction-normalized inputs plus positive monotonic constraints preserve every frozen factor direction, while a fixed three-level interaction catalog tests nonlinear complementarity without selecting a subset or reclassifying an old terminal factor.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: complete_library_signed_linear_ridge_or_unconstrained_weights
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Negative coefficients could systematically invert frozen terminal directions and would reopen the signed-weight family that Campaign102 deliberately excluded.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: complete_library_l1_subset_or_top_feature_selection
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Sparse selection would turn previously exposed factor outcomes into a subset search and violate the requirement to reuse the complete frozen feature library.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: unconstrained_random_forest_neural_network_or_generic_boosting
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Unconstrained nonlinear models can invert directions and introduce architecture, initialization and hyperparameter multiplicity outside a finite interpretable campaign.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: bounded_simplex_ridge_consensus_or_improvement_refit
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign102 and the later consensus/improvement definitions already consumed those exact linear and deterministic aggregation families; changing their component count would be a retry.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: minute_sequence_transformer_recurrent_or_convolutional_model
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Returning to raw terminal minute paths would reopen an exposed operator frontier, abandon the complete frozen factor library, and add large architecture search multiplicity.

selected_family.direction_normalization: Every component is its average-tie cross-sectional favorable-direction percentile in (0,1]; missing is preserved through design construction and deterministically filled with neutral 0.5 only at model input.
